title: clematis dioica var. normalis
intro: Clematis dioica var. normalis, commonly known as American Virgin's Bower, is a perennial flowering plant native to eastern North America. The plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its various health benefits, including treating fever, rheumatism, and gastrointestinal issues, as well as its antiseptic and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Clematis dioica var. normalis include its ability to reduce inflammation, relieve pain, and support the immune system. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its traditional use in herbal remedies.
